stories.title: User Login Page
stories.description: As a registered user, I want to log in using my email and password so that I can securely access the application dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Display a login page with email and password input fields.
Display a 'Remember Me' checkbox below the password field.
Display a 'Forgot Password?' link that redirects users to the password recovery page.
Provide a 'Login' button that submits the login form.
Validate that the email is in a valid format before submission.
Validate that the password field is not empty and contains at least 8 characters.
Display appropriate validation messages for invalid inputs.
Authenticate the user using the backend login API.
Redirect authenticated users to the dashboard upon successful login.
Display an error message if the login credentials are invalid.
business_rules: Only registered and active users are allowed to log in.
Users with invalid credentials must not be authenticated.
The login form must prevent submission if validation fails.
User sessions must be authenticated using JWT access tokens.
api_requirements: POST /api/v1/auth/login - Request: {email, password}, Response: 200 OK with {access_token, token_type, user}
GET /api/v1/users/me - Retrieve authenticated user details after successful login.
database_tables: users: id (UUID, primary key), first_name (VARCHAR), last_name (VARCHAR), email (VARCHAR, unique), password_hash (VARCHAR), is_active (BOOLEAN), created_at (TIMESTAMP), updated_at (TIMESTAMP)
validation_rules: Email is mandatory and must follow RFC 5322 email format.
Password is mandatory and must contain a minimum of 8 characters.
Email and password fields cannot contain only whitespace.
Login button remains enabled only when required fields are filled.
ui_requirements: Display the login form inside a centered card.
Place the company logo above the login heading.
Use rounded input fields with placeholder text.
Provide a password visibility toggle icon.
Use a primary blue login button with rounded corners.
Display the 'Remember Me' checkbox on the left and 'Forgot Password?' link on the right.
The page must be fully responsive for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
